title: Surviving the Dry Season: A Lion's Search for Water

scenes.heading: When the land dries
scenes.caption: The dry season changes the daily routine
scenes.narration: Across the African savanna, the dry season can last for months. Grass turns pale, shallow pools disappear, and every animal must adjust its routine to find enough water.

scenes.heading: A lion follows familiar routes
scenes.caption: Memory helps locate dependable water
scenes.narration: A lion does not wander at random. It moves through a familiar territory, using remembered paths and the changing activity of other animals to locate places where water may remain.

scenes.heading: The waterhole comes into view
scenes.caption: A rare pool becomes a vital resource
scenes.narration: As the lion reaches a waterhole, it slows down and checks the surroundings. Water is essential, but a crowded drinking place can also bring competition and unexpected danger.

scenes.heading: Drinking takes patience
scenes.caption: The lion lowers its head to the surface
scenes.narration: The lion bends its head and begins to drink. Its tongue curls water into the mouth in repeated laps, while ripples spread outward across the surface.

scenes.heading: A moment to recover
scenes.caption: Rest helps conserve energy in the heat
scenes.narration: After drinking, the lion raises its head and pauses. During the hottest hours, resting in shade and avoiding unnecessary movement helps conserve energy until conditions become cooler.

scenes.heading: The journey continues
scenes.caption: Survival depends on adapting to change
scenes.narration: The waterhole is only one part of survival. As the seasons shift, lions must keep finding food, shelter and safe routes through a landscape that never stays the same.
